_comment: Direct-sold ad placements for VR.org. All slots ship inactive: with active=false a slot renders NOTHING on the live site (no DOM, no layout change). To run a real placement, set active=true and fill imageUrl (creative, min 2x pixel density recommended), linkUrl (click destination), and alt. Optional: imageUrlDark for a dark-theme-specific creative, label to override the 'Sponsored' tag. This file is volume-mounted on the VPS and read at request time, so activating an ad is a data edit + git push, no Docker rebuild needed. Slots map to: homepage-hero (flagship banner, top of homepage), homepage-in-feed (native card in the homepage feed), sidebar-rectangle (300x250 in the sidebar, site-wide), buyer-guide-banner (leaderboard on the best-of / pillar pages).
